:::{#exr-prac-exp-mle-oinf}
#### Observed information for the exponential mean

In the setting of @exr-prac-exp-mle, use the [second derivative](https://morrison-lab.github.io/mds/calculus-derivatives.html#def-second-derivative) from @exr-prac-exp-mle-second-derivative to derive the [observed information](https://morrison-lab.github.io/sds/intro-MLEs.html#def-oinf)
$I(\pmean; \vx) = -\hess(\pmean; \vx)$.

:::
